land.label: Land, about 2 acres of US 27 frontage south of SR 60
land.assumption: No vacant commercial land price on US 27 turned up in the research, and the acreage and price records for the one listed fuel property on the corridor conflict with each other; the study carries $350,000 an acre as a placeholder and makes an appraisal the first lender condition.

store_sf.label: Store size, square feet
store_sf.assumption: Yesway's legacy store average of 3,400 sq ft [^31]; it also falls in Polk County's 2,000 to 3,499 sq ft commercial tier for the non-ad valorem charge [^22].

building_psf.label: Building and canopy cost, dollars per store square foot
building_psf.assumption: Upper half of a 2026 contractor guide's $150 to $350 per square foot for store plus canopy [^34]; wind-load design and the 16.9% year-over-year rise in steel mill product prices to June 2026 [^36] push a Florida canopy above the midpoint.

tank_cost.label: Installed cost per tank, complete
tank_cost.assumption: Set at the middle of the $60,000 to $380,000 a fuel-system vendor quotes for a finished tank installation (guide updated August 18, 2026) [^35]; a high water table can push excavation and anchoring toward the top of that band.

dispensers.label: Dispensers, two with auto-lane diesel
dispensers.assumption: Twelve fueling positions; diesel on two islands for pickups, farm and contractor trucks, not tractor-trailers.

dispenser_cost.label: Cost per dispenser
dispenser_cost.assumption: Middle of the vendor's $25,000 to $75,000 table range per dispenser [^35].

sitework.label: Site work, stormwater, wastewater, paving and signage
sitework.assumption: Allowance; it includes an onsite wastewater system because central sewer along this stretch of US 27 is not confirmed (the corridor's one listed fuel property shows septic) and Florida stormwater retention.

contingency_pct.label: Hard-cost contingency
contingency_pct.assumption: A 5% cushion on the store, tanks and site work, sized for a priced but unbid Polk County job.

soft.label: Design, permits, Phase I, survey and legal
soft.assumption: Allowance covering design, permits, survey, legal work and the Phase I report every fuel-site loan file needs whatever its size [^38]. Polk County impact and connection fees were not found.

ffe.label: Store fixtures, coolers, roller grill and point of sale
ffe.assumption: Allowance for a store without a full kitchen.

fuel_inventory.label: Opening gasoline and diesel inventory
fuel_inventory.assumption: Holiday's 2025 franchise disclosure sets opening fuel stock at $100,000 to $300,000, a contractor reports [^37]; two fuels and three tanks put this store above the bottom of that band.

merch_inventory.label: Opening merchandise inventory
merch_inventory.assumption: Allowance for shelf stock in a store without a kitchen.

working_capital.label: Pre-opening payroll, training and working capital
working_capital.assumption: About two months of modelled fixed costs.

gas_day.label: Gasoline gallons sold per day
gas_day.assumption: Stabilizes about 18% under the roughly 4,000 gallons a day NACS gives for the typical store [^28]. US 27 is the town's main highway and FDOT projects 42,800 to 52,800 vehicles a day on it by 2040 [^3], but its page gives no year for today's counts, and a Murphy USA, two RaceTracs and a Love's already sell to the corridor.

diesel_day.label: Diesel gallons sold per day
diesel_day.assumption: Small auto-lane volume from farm, grove and contractor pickups; tractor-trailers fuel at the Love's down the road, which lists 83 truck parking spaces and 7 DEF lanes [^15].

gas_price.label: Retail gasoline price per gallon (2026 U.S. forecast)

diesel_price.label: Retail diesel price per gallon (2026 U.S. forecast)

gas_margin.label: Gasoline gross margin per gallon
gas_margin.assumption: Close to Murphy USA's 28.1-cent retail fuel margin for 2025 [^32], the price-leader benchmark, and below the 39.7-cent national average for 2024 [^28]; an unbranded store next to a Murphy USA and two RaceTracs prices to them.

inside_sales.label: Inside sales
inside_sales.assumption: Under the $1.7 million an older Yesway store sold inside in 2025 [^31]: Lake Wales households earn a median $56,347 against $74,568 statewide, and 22.4% of residents live below the poverty line against 12.6% for Florida [^1,2].

inside_margin.label: Inside gross margin
inside_margin.assumption: Under the 35.2% Yesway earned on inside sales in 2025 [^31]; without a made-to-order kitchen the mix leans to lower-margin packaged goods.

staff_shift.label: Staff on the floor per hour
staff_shift.assumption: Two on the floor around the clock, leaner than the 2.6 per shift Yesway reports across its chain [^31], which a store without a kitchen can manage.

hours.label: Hours open per day
hours.assumption: Around the clock for highway and early-shift farm and grove trade; competitor hours were not found.

burden.label: Payroll taxes and benefits
burden.assumption: Covers Florida employer payroll taxes, workers' compensation and modest benefits; the research has no Polk County figure.

inflation.label: Yearly escalation of payroll and fixed costs
inflation.assumption: Close to the 3.4% rise in consumer prices to August 2026 [^33].

utilities.label: Electricity, water and propane, Year 1
utilities.assumption: Allowance for round-the-clock cooling and lighting in central Florida heat; the parcel's electric provider was not confirmed.

repairs.label: Repairs, supplies and tank compliance, Year 1
repairs.assumption: Allowance including the tank and line tests a fuel-site lender expects to see documented [^38].

insurance.label: Insurance including windstorm, Year 1
insurance.assumption: Higher than an inland Texas or Ohio store because Lake Wales took hurricane damage in 2004 and from Irma in 2017 [^12]; no quote was found, so a binding quote is a lender condition.

admin.label: Accounting, licenses and permits, Year 1
admin.assumption: Allowance; the research does not list Florida's agriculture department fuel registration, tank registration, alcohol or tobacco license fees.

tax_mills.label: Combined millage inside Lake Wales, 2025, as a rate

nav_charge.label: Polk non-ad valorem charge, commercial 2,000 to 3,499 sq ft

reserve_pct.label: Annual equipment reserve, percent of dispensers and fixtures
reserve_pct.assumption: Sets aside enough each year to replace dispensers and fixtures over roughly two decades.

uses.label: Design, permits, Phase I and legal
Fixtures, coolers and point of sale
Initial gasoline, diesel and shelf stock

opex.label: Wages and payroll costs
opex.expr: staff_shift * hours * 365 * wage * (1 + burden) * (1 + inflation) ** y

opex.label: Property tax
opex.expr: (land + store_sf * building_psf + tanks * tank_cost + sitework + dispensers * dispenser_cost + ffe) * tax_mills
